transcript.text: Hi everyone. We're approaching the Monday 09:00 UTC launch for the real-time collaboration service, and before I finalize the binding policy, we need to go through the standard readiness review. I'd like to hear from each of you — backend engineering, reliability, privacy, and customer success — on whether you have any concerns or sign-offs. Let's start with backend engineering. Are there any issues we should be aware of?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to raise a concern before we sign off. This afternoon, while investigating an unrelated mobile performance report, I confirmed that mobile clients resume from background in bursts and currently retry every 5 seconds — which is the default interval in our launch plan. This can create a reconnect storm under our 10% rollout with up to 10,000 concurrent connections. I recommend we set the retry interval to exactly 30 seconds in the rollout policy before finalizing. I have not yet filed the client-library ticket for this.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical capacity concern before we finalize. About 20 minutes ago, I completed a production-traffic replay and confirmed that the collaboration cluster's safe connection ceiling for Monday is exactly 6,000 concurrent connections — not the 10,000 currently in the draft plan. The autoscaling limit hasn't been updated yet because the replay results are still being attached to the capacity worksheet. Combined with Rafael's reconnect storm concern, I strongly recommend we lower the concurrent connection cap to 6,000 before Maya records the binding policy.

transcript.text: I need to raise a privacy concern before we finalize. This morning I completed a privacy review and confirmed two requirements that conflict with the current draft plan: first, collaboration content for EU accounts must remain in the EU processing region — the draft plan currently stores all collaboration data in the primary production region. Second, session transcripts must be deleted after exactly 30 days, not the 90 days currently in the draft plan. I haven't opened the compliance ticket yet because legal was still reviewing the wording, but these are binding requirements that need to be reflected in the launch policy before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to raise a customer success concern before we finalize. An hour ago I reconciled the customer-success rollout spreadsheet and confirmed that six accounts — acct-204, acct-219, acct-233, acct-241, acct-278, and acct-301 — have administrator opt-out commitments until their enablement sessions are complete. These six accounts must be excluded from Monday's 10% rollout. I have not updated the launch checklist yet, but this needs to be reflected in the binding policy before Maya records it.
